info.title: SixteenMemory API
info.description: The deployed explicit-memory API. Server-side integrations should use a user-scoped Bearer key. Cross-origin browser calls are rejected. Source evidence is supplied by the application, not extracted by a model. All successful operations return HTTP 200. JSON request bodies are limited to 64 KiB; content and source text to 8,000 UTF-16 code units. Fields outside the documented input schema are ignored, not supported features. Intelligence, metadata filters, ingestion, evidence and reindex endpoints belong to an unreleased candidate and are deliberately absent. The answer endpoint requires a configured provider and may incur costs; it was disabled in the public deployment when this document was released.

sessionCookie.name: sixteen_session
sessionCookie.description: Same-origin console only. Authorization headers take precedence.

CreateMemory.description: expires_at defaults to null. A new expiry must be in the future. request_id is scoped to the credential for 30 days. Reuse the identical JSON payload, including field order, on retry; a changed payload returns 409. A deleted or expired record returns 410 during that period.

UpdateMemory.description: Replaces content and source, sets status to active, and increments version. Omitted expires_at resets expiry to null. User scope cannot change.

SearchInput.description: Only lexical search is supported in this API version. A scoped key always stays within its user. Omitting user_id with an administrator credential searches the whole project.

score.description: Lexical ranking score, not a probability.

usage.description: Provider-specific usage data or null; no provider response shape is guaranteed.
